subject: Draft MAP and sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form — Nexa Health
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP and sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form — Nexa Health

Alex — attaching our initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a lightweight sequencing matrix for the MSA / DPA / order form + PO handoff. High level notes up front: 

- Goal: sign MSA + DPA and receive PO within a 4–6 week window, with a pilot order form executed as the gating purchase artifact.
- Dependencies called out in the MAP: legal redlines (MSA), DPA review & security evidence, procurement PO approval, and internal budget owner sign-off.
- Proposal: run DPA review and procurement intake in parallel; target a single MSA redline round with final sign-off after DPA is substantively agreed.

Please see MAP_Nexa_v1.xlsx attached — it has suggested owners and target SLAs for each step. Can you review and confirm whether your procurement and security timelines match the right-hand column? If acceptable, propose 60-minute joint sequencing call windows next week so we can lock owners and dates.

Attachments: MAP_Nexa_v1.xlsx (excel)

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwoodinference.com
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@nexahealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <pri.yom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nexa Procurement <procurement@nexahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form — Nexa Health

Thanks, Priyom — received and appreciate the clear breakdown. Quick feedback from procurement/security sync this morning: 

- Our security team has a hard requirement to see SOC 2 evidence and a standard DPA before legal will greenlight any PO. SOC 2 in your public pack is fine but they may ask for an attestation letter.
- Procurement prefers the DPA to be agreed before we approve the PO; they can tolerate parallel MSA redlines but want the DPA gating the PO issuance.
- We attached our procurement checklist (Nexa_Procurement_Checklist.pdf) for reference; it lists internal approval owners and typical PO cadence.

We can do a joint sequencing call on Tue 15 June between 10–12 ET or Wed 16 June 2–4 ET.

Also: do you have a sample order form (line items + pilot pricing) we can share with budget owners ahead of the call?

Best,
Alex Mercer
Director, Strategic Sourcing — Nexa Health
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <pri.yom@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form — Nexa Health

Priyom — looping in the legal perspective. Reading Alex's note we should be explicit about two routing options and the effort each requires:

Option A (preferred by Nexa): DPA negotiated and signed prior to PO issuance; MSA redlines proceed in parallel and final MSA signature follows PO as commercial close. Estimated internal review: DPA 5–7 business days for first pass; MSA 8–10 business days for a redline round.

Option B (faster procurement path): Execute short-form order form + PO to allow pilot work to begin under existing standard terms while MSA/DPA are finalized. This requires our legal comfort with fallback language in the order form and acceptance of risk profile.

Practical asks from legal for sequencing call:
- Confirm whether Nexa can accept DPA as a pre-PO requirement (owner: Nexa Legal).
- Confirm SOC 2 artifact level (attestation vs report).
- If Nexa wants Option B, identify the PO owner and who will sign the order form.

I attached a short DPA review guide (DPA_review_guide.docx) that explains typical redline hotspots to keep the call efficient. Priyom — please propose owner names for each row in the MAP and a decision deadline we can present to Nexa on the call.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form — Nexa Health

Thanks all — summary and proposed owner matrix below. Planning to send a calendar invite for Tue 15 Jun 10:30–11:30 ET (Alex, please let me know if that slot still works).

Proposed sequencing (high level):
1) Week 0 (pre-call): Nexa circulates procurement checklist and confirms SOC 2 artifact level. (Owner: Nexa Procurement)
2) Week 1: Joint sequencing call to confirm owners, choose Option A or B, and set decision deadlines. (Owners: Priyom / Alex)
3) Weeks 1–2: DPA review (target first-pass comments within 5 business days). (Owner: Laura / Nexa Legal)
4) Weeks 1–3: Order form / PO intake and approval (parallel). If Option B chosen, pilot order form executed to allow limited work to start. (Owner: Nexa Procurement / Priyom)
5) Weeks 2–4+: MSA redline consolidation and final signature (Owner: Redwood Legal / Nexa Legal)

Attachments for the call: MAP_Nexa_v1.xlsx, Nexa_Procurement_Checklist.pdf, DPA_review_guide.docx

Next steps:
- Alex: confirm SOC 2 artifact (attestation vs full report) and confirm the 10:30 ET slot on Tue 15 Jun.
- Nexa Procurement: identify PO signatory and internal decision deadlines prior to the call.
- Laura/Karthik: prepare a 10-minute legal framing doc for the call covering redline hotspots and fallback language if Option B is pursued.

I'll send the invite and a condensed one-pager of the MAP before EOD today.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: MAP_Nexa_v1.xlsx, Nexa_Procurement_Checklist.pdf, DPA_review_guide.docx
